title: Derivation of Peak Time and Peak Value for Underdamped Second-Order Step Response
expert_review: A classic and essential derivation in control systems theory. The problem reinforces understanding of step response behavior and requires careful calculus and trigonometry.
source: Adapted from standard control systems textbook problem (e.g., P6.2)
learning_objectives: Derive the time derivative of the underdamped second-order step response.
Solve for the time instants where the step response derivative is zero.
Identify which extremum corresponds to the first peak overshoot.
Derive the analytical expressions for peak time (t_p) and peak value (y_p).
Understand the relationship between damping ratio (ζ), natural frequency (ω_n), and transient response metrics.
